caseName: Colorado Anti-Discrimination Commission v. Continental Air Lines, Inc.
caseNameFull: Colorado Anti-Discrimination Commission v. Continental Air Lines, Inc.
attorneys: Stanley Mosk, Attorney General of California, on the motion.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 371 U. S. 809, to the Supreme Court of Colorado. The motion of the State of California for leave to argue, as amicus curiae, is granted and twenty minutes are allotted for that purpose. Counsel for the respondent is allotted an additional twenty minutes to argue this case.
